chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
The worth of every man is in his attainments.

key_terms.يُحْسِنُهُ: He excels in it, or his proficiency

ai.seo_question: What determines the true worth of a person according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) defines human worth through competence and excellence, a concept deeply rooted in the Shia emphasis on *'ilm* (knowledge) and *'amal* (action) as the true markers of nobility. This maxim, found in *Nahj al-Balagha*, challenges pre-Islamic tribal hierarchies by asserting that merit, rather than lineage or social status, determines a person's value. It serves as a practical guideline for evaluating individuals in both spiritual and worldly contexts, highlighting the importance of continuous self-improvement.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 81. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
The worth of every man is in his attainments. [1]
